_meta.notes: Form title has no year ('Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'); clerk stamp reads JAN 28 2011, signature date 1-28-11, so this is the year-end report for calendar 2010 (manifest calls it the 2010 Summary Report - consistent). This form has BOTH a top-row 'Office' box and an 'Office Sought' box; both are filled with 'County Council At-Large "C"'. Line 1 Columns A and B are written '500.' followed by a dash for the cents (a written-out zero-cents convention), recorded verbatim as '500.-'. Line 2 Columns A and B and Line 6 are a slashed zero (0). NEITHER the amendment Yes nor the No box is checked, so is_amendment is left blank.

contributions.detail: exact; the single row's amount is written '500.-' and the printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED are both written '500.-' as well, matching Summary Page line 1 Column A verbatim. Per the currency convention a trailing dash after whole dollars means no cents, i.e. 500.00; the verbatim glyph string is retained in the amount field

expenditures.detail: exact; Schedule B (p4) EXISTS and is BLANK - 'None' is written in the first Date cell and the TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE cell carries a slashed-zero glyph. Per the zero-glyph ruling a slashed zero IS 0, so this is a real zero with zero rows, not a gap
